units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:1">Sabb. XIII, 1</cite>; a. fr. Y. M. Kat. III, end, 83ᵈ, what is meant by <cite ref="A01204"><he>אִיחוּי</he></cite>? Ans. <he>כאריג</he> when it looks as if woven.

<cite ref="Megillah 26b">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>טווי לא׳</he> spinning the flax so as to prepare it for weaving (indirect preparation or designation); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 48a:12">Snh. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>טווי לאֲרִיגָה</he>, (Rashi <he>לאריג</he>).
